scope: Settings local storage failure feedback and retry
source_evidence: SettingsView previously awaited getEnginePortOverride and setEnginePortOverride without catching rejected Chrome storage calls.
The pair-code Save handler awaited setPairToken without a rejection handler, leaving entered code intact but no error.
Clear local data closed its confirmation before awaiting chrome.storage.local.clear; a rejected clear left the user with no visible failure.
root_cause: Settings click and load handlers assumed Chrome storage operations could not reject, and reset indicated completion before storage confirmed it.
sibling_census: Port read, replacement, and removal: repaired in SettingsView.
Manual desktop pair-code write: repaired in SettingsView.
Clear local data: repaired in SettingsView; confirmation remains open until clear and sign-out succeed.
Zustand persisted preferences write asynchronously through a shared adapter; this repair does not claim to cover that different persistence path.
